name: select-next-work
job: Select and claim the next high-value Work from evidence under WIP limits: one tick, bounded outcome, compact report.

inScope: Resolving org, project, and live Work authority
Inspecting queue, claims, capacity, and material signals
Deduplicating to independently useful bounded outcomes
Claiming positive-net lanes under WIP and cost backpressure
outOfScope: Immortal chat sessions as continuous mode
Closing claimed multi-phase objectives inside a tick
Claiming delivery outcomes without delivery evidence

inputs: Live queue, claims, capacity, and signals
outputs: Durable claim and checkpoint effects where authority surfaces exist
failureSemantics: Only positive-net lanes are claimed under WIP and cost backpressure; continuous mode requires an external scheduler, bounded WIP, and readout; the tick ends after a compact report.

outcome.observable: A bounded tick report that selects and claims the next positive-net Work under WIP limits, with durable claim or checkpoint effects recorded where authority surfaces exist.
